name: Entity Confirmation
description: Lets you customize entity save-confirmation messages and post-save redirects.
project_description:
Often times the default entity save message is insufficient or too boring. Customize the default message shown after the entity create, edit, and delete operations are completed. Configurations for each operation are available on individual form modes for maximum flexibility.

 Documentation 
 https://git.drupalcode.org/project/entity_confirmation
